installedVersion: Submitted after R109 handoff; version not embedded in CPU profile
method: Attribute each preceding timeDelta to its sampled leaf, walk ancestors with frame deduplication; windows split intervals at boundaries. These are sampled wall-time fractions, not OS CPU utilization, invocation durations, or call counts.
limits: Inclusive rows overlap and must not be added.
CPU profile includes main process only, not reward worker/world/channel processes or mobile rendering.
Sample timeDelta is not a function-duration measure and does not bound event-loop stalls.
Sampled native SQL includes synchronous native/blocking work; cannot infer instruction CPU versus disk wait.
One 60-second capture cannot establish 100-player capacity, player count, leak, or exact SQL row cardinality.
No live VDS changes or deployment.
